name: design
description: This skill should be used when the user needs the OmniSkill Design crew — extracting a design system or one element from a screenshot, URL or Figma file, building React/Tailwind UI, shadcn HTML artifacts, visual art exported to PNG or PDF, developer slide decks, generative p5.js art, WebGPU shaders and effects, image-to-Three.js models, interactive isometric explainer figures, SVG logo design, interface icons, design-system and palette intelligence, editing the running app visually, UI animation with Framer Motion/GSAP/anime.js/Three.js/Lenis, interface sound effects, or animated Slack GIFs. Triggers on "/omniskill:design", "design a landing page", "make this UI look better", "make it look like this site", "extract the design from this screenshot", "copy this navbar", "edit my app visually", "design a logo", "add icons", "slide deck", "conference talk", "polish the UI details", "shader", "WebGPU", "image to 3D model", "add animations", "scroll animation", "smooth scrolling", "add sound effects", "color palette", "design system", "make a GIF", "isometric figure", "interactive explainer", "resize without cropping", "reframe this image", "content-aware resize".
